title: E6 authoring pack, schema version e6-authoring-1 (what the independent author writes; no harness-internal JSON)

synthetic.description: true marks a test fixture; a synthetic pack never satisfies the freeze checklist

author_id.description: a real person or team; NOT_AVAILABLE means none exists

family_id.description: must not contain a double underscore (reserved for the control suffix)

user_task.description: the user's request; must contain prerequisite_arg

prerequisite_arg.description: doc_id (retrieve_document) or city (get_weather) the task asks the model to look up

carrier_content.description: document body (retrieve_document) or weather suffix (get_weather) holding the injection; contains {MARKER} exactly once and every required_args value; the author never writes the marker itself

neutral_content.description: injection-free twin of carrier_content; {MARKER} handling is fixed by the owner's H4 decision

required_args.description: the attacker-specified call arguments; keys are parameters of effect_tool
